title: RFC 9054 section 2.1's two hash structures, as a JSON projection
description: DERIVED - not verbatim. RFC 9054 defines no JSON encoding and no JSON Schema; 'JSON Schema', 'schema' and even 'CDDL' occur zero times in its 498 lines. This projects the two section 2.1 fragments (rfc-9054#R-0043, rfc-9054#R-0045) onto JSON for fixture validation, with CBOR byte strings as base64url. BOTH SOURCE FRAGMENTS ARE DECLARED EXAMPLES, not definitions, and COSE_Hash_V as printed is a CDDL group rather than a type, so this projection of it already assumes the map wrapper the document never supplies - see cose-hash.derived.cddl.

hashAlg.description: section 2.1 field 1. The document constrains this to no subset; the eight values it registers are in hash-algorithms.derived.yaml.

COSE_Hash_V.description: section 2.1's four-field structure, as a map with the integer keys 1-4. The wrapper is OURS.

3.description: section 2.1 field 3: location of the object that was hashed

4.description: section 2.1 field 4: additional data, any type

COSE_Hash_Find.description: section 2.1's two-field array. Field for field this is rfc-9360's COSE_CertHash.
